answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 32396 Country: India Title: Nikah with Khala Question: Is it possible in islam to merry with his khala tell me in brief also told me about the punish in islam recarding this also told me how allah will punish. Answer ID: 32396 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1129/714/H=1432) (1) Nikah is haram with real, allati and akhyafi khala (sister of your mother from her father side or her mother side). (2) He is open transgressor (fasiq). (3) Almighty Allah knows best how the punishment shall be implemented upon him. We have no knowledge about it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
